name: Ground uplight
description: An in-ground uplight: a black aluminum rim around a warm frosted lens, set flush in the paving.

made_with.settings: smart topology, main view only, textured, PBR

notes: Prepared with tools/prep_prop.py. Prepared at 0.25 m across with --glow 0.75: the lens glows. Meshy modelled the buried housing too; Claude sliced it off 3.5 cm below the top, so only the rim and lens sit above the ground.
